title: DFT setup and reference energies
action: Determine the equilibrium lattice constant of bcc W; compute the total energy of a 128-atom pure W supercell; compute the reference energy per atom of bulk hcp Re and hcp Os.
description: Establish the structural and energetic baselines for the supercell calculations.

title: Substitutional Re and Os total energies
action: Compute total energies of the 128-atom W supercell with one substitutional Re atom and with one substitutional Os atom.
description: Total energies of Re and Os substitutional defects in W.

title: Vacancy and Re/Os-vacancy complexes
action: Compute total energies for a single vacancy in pure W, and for Re-V and Os-V pairs with the vacancy at the 1NN and 2NN positions relative to the solute.
description: Energies needed to derive Re-V and Os-V binding energies.

title: SIA formation and crowdion binding
action: Compute total energies of the <111> crowdion SIA in pure W, in W-Re, and in W-Os, and of the same SIA configurations with the solute at the nearest-neighbor position along the <111> string.
description: Energies for SIA formation and crowdion-solute binding.

title: SIA rotation barriers
action: Compute total energies of the SIA in the <110> dumbbell configuration for pure W, W-Re, and W-Os to obtain the rotation energy barrier <111>→<110>.
description: Energies for the rotation barrier estimation.

title: Assemble and report derived quantities
action: Using the total energies from the previous steps, compute the binding energies, formation energies, and rotation barriers according to the standard DFT supercell formulas. Write the results as a JSON file with the required keys.
description: Final reproduction artifact containing all target DFT-derived quantities.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: re_re_binding_eV, os_os_binding_eV, re_os_binding_eV, re_vac_1nn_binding_eV, re_vac_2nn_binding_eV, os_vac_1nn_binding_eV, os_vac_2nn_binding_eV, sia_111_formation_pure_W_eV, sia_111_formation_W_Re_eV, sia_111_formation_W_Os_eV, crowdion_re_binding_1nn_eV, crowdion_os_binding_1nn_eV, rotation_barrier_pure_W_eV, rotation_barrier_W_Re_eV, rotation_barrier_W_Os_eV. All values as floats with at least 2 decimal places.
